{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","payload":{"objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 connects to a login prompt, and keep it running until ready.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process booted from /app/alpine.iso","A reachable telnet service on 127.0.0.1:6665"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU must be started in the background","Port 6665 must accept telnet connections locally","Connection should present a login prompt","The process must remain running after readiness is reached"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying the ISO file exists","Only starting QEMU without exposing telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665","Only checking that a process exists without confirming telnet/login prompt readiness","Treating boot logs or non-interactive output as sufficient"],"verification_plan":["Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and QEMU availability","Start QEMU with a serial console redirected to tcp:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait or equivalent","Wait until the telnet port is reachable and the login prompt is observed","Record receipt-backed evidence of the running process and prompt readiness"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt showing QEMU launch command and background process start","Receipt showing successful connection to 127.0.0.1:6665","Receipt showing the login prompt from the guest"],"notes":["Prerequisites like tool availability are not success by themselves; the task is complete only when telnet reaches the guest login prompt."]}},{"type":"plan_update","payload":{"objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1:6665 connects to a login prompt, and keep it running until ready.","current_focus":"Discover available tools/files and launch QEMU with serial console on TCP port 6665.","implementation_approach":["Inspect filesystem for /app/alpine.iso and QEMU binary availability.","If QEMU exists, start it with a TCP serial console bound to 127.0.0.1:6665 in server mode.","Poll readiness by connecting to the port and waiting for the login prompt.","Keep the VM running in the background."],"validation_strategy":["Use measured evidence from shell output or receipts to confirm the launch command and background process.","Use telnet or an equivalent TCP client to confirm the port is open and the guest login prompt appears."],"verification_test_strategy":["Attempt a local connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 after launch.","Observe guest prompt text rather than relying on process existence alone."],"known_bad_behavior":["Assuming readiness from file existence or command success alone.","Stopping after launch without confirming the login prompt.","Re-running equivalent checks without new evidence."],"evidence_gaps":["Need confirmation that /app/alpine.iso exists and QEMU is installed.","Need receipt-backed evidence of a running QEMU instance and prompt readiness."],"risks":["QEMU may be missing or the ISO may require different boot parameters.","The guest may not expose login on the serial console without correct QEMU options."],"next_steps":["Inspect environment for ISO and QEMU.","Launch VM with serial TCP console.","Verify telnet prompt readiness."],"evidence_required_before_finalization":["Receipt-backed evidence of QEMU launch.","Receipt-backed evidence of telnet connectivity to 127.0.0.1:6665.","Receipt-backed evidence of the login prompt."]}}]}

payload.command:
set -e
ls -l /app/alpine.iso
command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-aarch64 || true
command -v telnet || true
